title: test(gen): shadow .dev.vars in test env so live keys stay skipped
author: iotserver24
pr_body_excerpt:
## Summary
- Add Gen test-only `.dev.vars.test` so local development keys do not enter the Workers test environment.
- Keep provider-gated tests skipped unless explicitly supplied with test credentials.

Addresses #13475
Fixes #15411

## Test plan
- [x] With a dummy `ELEVENLABS_API_KEY` in local `.dev.vars`, focused ElevenLabs tests used `.dev.vars.test`: 14 passed, 4 skipped.

gist.headline: Keys stay in their garden
gist.blurb: Gen’s test hive now uses its own credential patch. Local development keys remain safely out of Workers tests, while provider checks still wait for intentionally supplied test credentials.
gist.summary: Added gen.pollinations.ai/.dev.vars.test so Workers tests shadow local .dev.vars credentials and keep provider-gated tests skipped unless explicit test keys are supplied.
gist.impact: Developers can run focused Gen tests without local provider keys such as ELEVENLABS_API_KEY unintentionally enabling live-key test paths.
gist.visual_concept: A cozy test garden with Polli tending two clearly separate seed packets: local development keys stay behind a small garden gate while a test-only patch feeds a retro terminal. The separation represents .dev.vars.test shadowing .dev.vars; code-plants and a small skipped-test sign keep the scene friendly and legible.
